state_schemes.name: Bihar Krishi Yantrikaran Yojana
state_schemes.description: Subsidy scheme for small and marginal farmers to purchase agricultural machinery and equipment for better productivity.
state_schemes.benefit: Subsidy up to 50% on selected farm machinery, with maximum limit based on equipment type.
state_schemes.notes: Implementation through district agriculture offices; verify current scheme guidelines on portal.

state_schemes.name: Diesel Anudan Yojana
state_schemes.description: Provides diesel subsidy to farmers for irrigation pumps during drought or deficit rainfall periods to protect standing crops.
state_schemes.benefit: Direct transfer of diesel subsidy per acre, usually announced during kharif/rabi seasons as per need.
state_schemes.notes: Seasonal; notifications appear on the Bihar Agriculture Department portal.

state_schemes.name: Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojana
state_schemes.description: State crop assistance scheme that provides compensation for crop loss due to natural calamities, replacing the previous PMFBY-based state contribution.
state_schemes.benefit: Compensation up to Rs. 10,000 per acre for crop loss; premium and additional support borne by the state.
state_schemes.notes: Scheme details and enrollment on the Bihar Agril portal; verify campaign dates.

state_schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana
state_schemes.description: Accident insurance scheme for farmers covering death and disability due to accidents during agricultural operations.
state_schemes.benefit: Insurance cover of Rs. 5 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability, partial disability benefits as per rules.
state_schemes.notes: Registration through UP Agripardarshi portal; nominal premium or free under state budget.

state_schemes.name: Uttar Pradesh Krishi Yantrikaran Yojana
state_schemes.description: Subsidy scheme for farmers to purchase agricultural implements like rotavator, seed drill, and power tillers.
state_schemes.benefit: 50% subsidy for SC/ST/women farmers, 40% for general category, on specified machinery with price caps.
state_schemes.notes: Online application through departmental portal; scheme often launched in phases.

state_schemes.name: Crop Residue Management Scheme
state_schemes.description: Provides subsidy on crop residue management machinery like Happy Seeder, Super SMS, and balers to prevent stubble burning.
state_schemes.benefit: 50% subsidy to individual farmers, 80% to cooperative societies/FPOs on approved equipment.
state_schemes.notes: Implemented by Punjab Agriculture Department; apply via online portal during seasonal windows.

state_schemes.name: Pani Bachao Paisa Kamao
state_schemes.description: Pilot incentive scheme to encourage farmers for using less electricity for irrigation, saving groundwater.
state_schemes.benefit: Direct cash incentive per unit of electricity saved compared to baseline usage, credited to bank account.
state_schemes.notes: Pilot scheme; may not be available statewide. Check Punjab Agriculture portal for enrollment.

state_schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
state_schemes.description: State income support scheme providing an additional Rs. 6,000 per year to farmers over and above PM-KISAN.
state_schemes.benefit: Total Rs. 12,000 per year (PM-KISAN Rs. 6,000 + state Rs. 6,000) in three installments.
state_schemes.notes: Auto-enrollment for PM-KISAN beneficiaries; check MP Krishi portal for status.

state_schemes.name: Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojana
state_schemes.description: Price deficiency payment scheme that compensates farmers when market prices fall below MSP for notified crops.
state_schemes.benefit: Difference between MSP and average market price (limited to state-specific cap) paid directly to farmer.
state_schemes.notes: Scheme active during specific seasons; check portal for notified crops and market yards.

state_schemes.name: Mera Pani Meri Virasat
state_schemes.description: Incentive scheme to encourage farmers to replace paddy with alternative crops like maize or pulses to save groundwater.
state_schemes.benefit: Rs. 7,000 per acre as incentive for diversifying from paddy to notified alternative crops.
state_schemes.notes: Seasonal enrollment via Haryana Agril portal; verify current rates and eligible crops.

state_schemes.name: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana
state_schemes.description: Price compensation scheme for farmers selling vegetables and fruits below cost of production to ensure minimum income.
state_schemes.benefit: Compensation of difference between market price and state-declared cost of production for notified vegetables.
state_schemes.notes: Implements through market committees; list of crops and base price notified periodically.
